size_note: edge of the black square (8 x 8 modules of 10 mm incl. black border)
marker_axes: OpenCV ArUco: x to the tag's right, y to its TOP edge, z out of the printed face; origin at the centre

placement.face: inside face: the face that is up in step 1, with the dowel holes and the groove for the drawer bottom
placement.position: centred along the 380 mm length; centred across the 130 mm height between the groove and the opposite long edge (the 100 mm cut square fits; keep the groove and dowel holes clear)
placement.orientation: the printed TOP edge of the marker points toward the groove edge; marker x runs along the 380 mm length, marker z points out of the inside face
placement.fixing: flat, no bubbles: glue stick or low-tack spray; tape only on the white margin, never on the black
placement.visibility: visible in steps 1-4 (front lying flat, sides going on); hidden once the bottom panel slides in. Apps must hold the last good pose (anchor) when the marker is lost.
